## Deck Goal
Teach Year-2 physics students to identify the state, rate and initial condition of a first-order model; translate the rate law into a scaffolded Forward Euler update; trace the loop; compare timesteps at the same final time; and validate the trajectory against physical checks and a supplied exact reference.
